parents.subject: Engineering Technology and Management for Agricultural Systems

ns2:course.label: Industrial and Agricultural Safety-Injury Prevention
ns2:course.description: Issues associated with industrial and agricultural injuries and effective interventions. Areas include: industrial and agricultural injury situations; injury causation; injury intervention strategies and their applications to agricultural and industrial issues; and, specific safety issues in the areas of machinery, grain and forage systems, animals, materials handling and storage, electricity, fire safety, special populations, and emergency preparedness. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours.
